reset_behavior.contract: Exactly one memset clears only the selected 772-byte Pak; signed +5 survives and is restored; adjacent Pak/guard bytes unchanged; sp/ra restored. Caller-clobbered registers are poisoned at memset.
reset_behavior.limitations: Private native boundary permits s0/s1 clobbers. Valid ports 0..3 only. This is a focused fail-closed integer interpreter with an explicit memset contract, not whole-system execution.
